salon.composition: Portrait-led editorial opening; service detail and booking stay close to the work.
salon.imagery: Owner-supplied portraits and real hair work, deliberately cropped.
salon.trust: Verified services, prices, team and booking destination.

construction.composition: Wide project evidence followed by measured service and process layouts.
construction.imagery: Real projects, material detail and site context.
construction.trust: Actual service area, completed project evidence and contact method.

technology.composition: A product-led opening, purposeful feature sequences and concise evaluation paths.
technology.imagery: Actual product interfaces, with one bounded interactive demonstration.
technology.trust: Real capabilities, limitations, pricing and support.

ai.composition: Show an understandable real input/output example before claims; explain constraints near the action.
ai.imagery: Authentic interface and explainable process diagrams.
ai.trust: Verified model capabilities, data handling and actual limitations.

automotive.composition: A large product silhouette with persistent specifications and a native detail path.
automotive.imagery: Licensed vehicle photography or a supplied 3D model; never fictional specifications.
automotive.trust: Verified model availability, specifications and enquiry process.

portfolio.composition: Work first, variable image scale and concise case-study narratives; direct contact.
portfolio.imagery: Real supplied work with honest demo/concept disclosures.
portfolio.trust: Actual work, owner role and real contact information.

ecommerce.composition: Product imagery, comparable facts and purchase state remain adjacent.
ecommerce.imagery: Real product photos with alternate views and useful detail.
ecommerce.trust: Verified price, stock, shipping, return policy and checkout integration.

real-estate.composition: Location-led listing discovery with clear filters, legible property facts and detail pages.
real-estate.imagery: Real property imagery, plans and location context.
real-estate.trust: Verified listings, property facts, agent identity and enquiry route.

restaurant.composition: One atmospheric food scene, readable menu and accessible reservation details.
restaurant.imagery: Actual dishes, interior and people with permission.
restaurant.trust: Actual menu, dietary information, hours, address and reservation integration.

crm.composition: Stable sidebar and task-first data views; table/list density adapts without hiding actions.
crm.imagery: Authentic workspace states; data examples explicitly labelled.
crm.trust: Real state transitions, permissions and save/error feedback.

other.composition: Prioritize the visitor task and available content; resolve the identity through actual references.
other.imagery: Owned assets that explain the business.
other.trust: Ask for verified business evidence and actual action destinations.
